info.name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace - CUSTOMER
info.description: Customer app: OTP auth, addresses, wallet, order placement/tracking, Razorpay payments, refunds, reviews, notifications, and the public browse surface (offers, banners, search, serviceability, geocoding, uploads).

item.name: Customer Auth
item.description: Phone+OTP based login (mounted at /auth/customer via auth.routes.ts) — no password.

item.name: Addresses
item.description: Self-scoped for the owning customer (an admin with CUSTOMER_UPDATE can also manage these — see the ADMIN collection).

item.name: Wallet
item.description: Self-scoped wallet balance and history. Crediting/debiting the wallet is admin-only — see the ADMIN collection.

item.name: Orders

request.description: vendorId is required for FOOD orders; use storeId instead for INSTAMART orders.

item.description: Order placement and self-scoped order tracking. Status transitions are driven by the vendor/delivery partner/admin — see the FOOD/INSTAMART/DELIVERY PARTNER collections.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Razorpay checkout flow for an order, plus self-scoped payment history.

item.name: Refunds
item.description: Self-scoped refund visibility. Manual refunds are only ever initiated by an admin — see the ADMIN collection.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Browsing is public; creating/editing/deleting your own review requires {{customerToken}}.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Per-account push-device registration and in-app notification inbox — any authenticated actor type, shown here with {{customerToken}}.

item.name: Browse (Offers, Banners, Search)
item.description: Public content the customer app renders before/without login.

item.name: Serviceability
item.description: Public — called before checkout to confirm the address falls inside an active delivery zone.

item.name: Geocoding
item.description: Used when the customer drops a pin or types a free-form address while adding an address.

item.name: Uploads
item.description: Used for review-photo attachments and profile pictures.
